claims.statement: APODOCK-001 is intentionally a large receptor-motion stress test rather than a routine cognate redocking benchmark.

evidence.notes: Prospective structural preflight only; 10/10 structurally eligible, 9/10 chemistry-ready, and no APODOCK Vina outcome.

notes.summary: The study evaluates ten apo/holo protein-ligand systems selected for substantial receptor conformational rearrangements, with reported backbone changes reaching 7.1 Å.

sources.title: Conformational Transitions upon Ligand Binding: Holo-Structure Prediction from Apo Conformations
